sample_rule: lowest SHA256(example_id) among train1421; first 64 design-exposed pilot, remaining 192 extension
gate: Report the first 64 separately. On the 192 extension, require at least 9 additional 0.80 repairs or 6 additional 0.90 repairs for further learnability design, with quality-first mean context increase <=10 tokens/query and no five-anchor baseline break. Otherwise close early ordering under current action space. This is an outcome-aware upper-bound gate, never proof of deployability.
